AcquisitionDefsConsent.description: The basis on which a participant's data may be published and redistributed, and how identifiable the retained data is. Separate from licensing, which governs the artifact, and from accessCondition, which governs the gate: a licence permits reuse, consent permits existence, an access condition permits retrieval, and all three must hold. Absent from all 26 record types in 0.8.0.

ethicsApprovals.description: Approvals this consent falls under, reusing pub.layers.defs#ethicsApproval rather than declaring a second shape.

expiresAt.description: When consent expires, if it does.

grantedAt.description: When consent was granted. MAY be coarsened for de-identification.

identifiability.description: How identifiable the retained data is (fallback when the Uri is unavailable). This decides whether the data may live in Layers at all. identifiable is a hard signal NOT to carry the bytes here: face video, unmodified voice, a full-head structural MRI and a clinically annotated iEEG montage are identifiable however the metadata is scrubbed, and a public PDS plus a firehose is the wrong container. Such data belongs behind media.externalUri with a matching accessCondition, with Layers holding only the description.

identifiabilityUri.description: AT-URI of the identifiability definition node.

notes.description: Free-text consent detail the typed fields do not capture.

scope.description: What redistribution the participant agreed to (fallback when scopeUri unavailable). not-redistributable and controlled-access are declarations that the underlying bytes MUST NOT be carried as a Layers blob and MUST instead be referenced by media.externalUri pointing at a gated repository.

scopeUri.description: AT-URI of the redistribution scope definition node (typeDef of consent-scope at layers-acquisition.ontology.layers.pub).

status.description: Current status (fallback when statusUri unavailable). A consumer MUST NOT redistribute data whose status is withdrawn.

statusUri.description: AT-URI of the consent status definition node.

withdrawalContact.description: Where a withdrawal request should be sent: a URL or an institutional address, never a personal one.

withdrawnAt.description: When consent was withdrawn. Its presence obliges the publisher to delete or tombstone the associated records and obliges every indexer to suppress them. It does NOT and cannot guarantee erasure: a record broadcast on the firehose or pulled by getRepo is outside the publisher's control, and Layers is a read-only indexer with no authority over third-party consumers. The normative consequence belongs stated rather than implied: do not write into a Layers record anything whose later erasure you would need to guarantee.

AcquisitionDefsLanguageCompetence.description: One language in a participant's repertoire, with the role it plays and how it was acquired. Composes pub.layers.defs#languageRef rather than re-declaring tag, script and grounding.

ageOfAcquisitionMonths.description: Age of first exposure in whole months.

features.description: Competence detail not yet promoted to a typed field.

language.description: The language, including sign languages (ase, bfi, gsg). Its role field carries l1, l2, heritage, signed-l1 and signed-l2: a hearing L2 signer and a deaf L1 signer are different participants for essentially every research question in the field.

proficiencyUri.description: AT-URI of the proficiency scale point definition node (typeDef of proficiency at layers-acquisition.ontology.layers.pub).

AcquisitionDefsRun.description: An uninterrupted acquisition within a session, sharing acquisition parameters and task throughout. BIDS run-<index>. Also the grouping object a media.defs#motionInfo tracking system points at, addressed by uuid.

eventLayerRef.description: AT-URI of a pub.layers.annotation.annotationLayer of kind tier carrying this run's trigger and event codes. This is where BIDS events.tsv lands.

features.description: Run-specific properties not yet promoted to a typed field.

judgmentSetRefs.description: AT-URIs of pub.layers.judgment.judgmentSet records collected during this run.

startNanos.description: Signed start on the session clock.

streams.description: Streams active during this run, as objectRefs into the session's streams.

task.description: Task slug for this run (fallback when taskUri unavailable), from the session task vocabulary.

taskUri.description: AT-URI of this run's task definition node, when it differs from the session's.

uuid.description: Stable identifier for this run within this session. Required because a motion tracking system points at a run by uuid, and a name join cannot be validated.

AcquisitionDefsStream.description: One synchronized media stream within a session, with its offset against the session clock. The uuid is what an anchor's pub.layers.defs#mediaScope.stream objectRef points at, and what pub.layers.media.media#stream resolves to.

driftPartsPerBillion.description: Signed measured clock drift against the session master, in parts per billion. Independent oscillators diverge measurably over an hour, and zero is a claim rather than a safe default.

features.description: Stream-specific properties not yet promoted to a typed field.

mediaCid.description: CID of the media revision this session's offsets were measured against, so a replaced recording is detectable rather than silently reinterpreted.

mediaRef.description: AT-URI of the pub.layers.media.media carrying this stream.

offsetNanos.description: Signed offset from the session clock's zero to this stream's first sample, session-relative and never UTC-epoch. Negative when the stream began before t=0, which BIDS StartTime explicitly permits. Duplicates media.sync.offsetNanos deliberately: the session is authoritative when the two disagree, because only the session sees all streams.

participantRef.description: AT-URI of the pub.layers.acquisition.participant this stream records, when the session has several and streams are per-participant.

streamId.description: Human-readable session-local label (cam-left, lapel-a, eeg, eyetrack-right, mocap-upper). Display cache, advisory: uuid is the join key.

streamRole.description: What this stream is FOR (fallback when streamRoleUri unavailable). Distinct from the medium's kind: two audio streams can be a close-talk and a room microphone, which are the same kind and not interchangeable.

streamRoleUri.description: AT-URI of the stream role definition node (typeDef of stream-role at layers-acquisition.ontology.layers.pub).

syncMethod.description: How this stream was aligned (fallback when syncMethodUri unavailable).

syncMethodUri.description: AT-URI of the synchronization method definition node (typeDef of sync-method at layers-acquisition.ontology.layers.pub), the same node set as media.defs#syncInfo.clockSourceUri.

syncUncertaintyNanos.description: Estimated alignment uncertainty in nanoseconds. A hardware trigger and a clapperboard differ by three orders of magnitude, and a consumer needs it to know how far to trust a cross-stream anchor.

uuid.description: Stable identifier for this stream within this session. Required because media records and anchors point at streams, and a session-local label string is a name join that cannot be validated.

cid.description: CID of this session record's indexed revision.

access.description: Conditions under which this participant's data may be obtained, when narrower than the collection's.

ageIsCapped.description: True when ageMonths is clamped and the true value is greater. Distinguishes a clamped 89-year-old from a real one.

ageMonths.description: Age at first participation in whole months, so infant, child-language and animal work is expressible without floats; NWB Subject.age uses an ISO 8601 duration for the same reason. BIDS caps participants.tsv age at 89 years for privacy, so values above 1068 SHOULD be clamped with ageIsCapped set. In small or clinical populations age alone is a quasi-identifier and may legitimately be omitted.

ageReference.description: What ageMonths is measured from (fallback when the Uri is unavailable). NWB Subject.age__reference, which takes birth or gestational. Load-bearing for infant work, where the two differ by months.

ageReferenceUri.description: AT-URI of the age reference definition node.

consent.description: REQUIRED. The basis on which this participant's data may be published and redistributed. Required rather than optional because a participant record with no consent declaration is a claim about a person with no stated warrant, and no consumer can tell an unrecorded consent from an absent one.

createdAt.description: When this participant record was created.

features.description: Study-specific variables (education, clinical group, screening scores). Keys SHOULD be declared as a column schema on the containing collection. MUST NOT reintroduce a direct identifier the typed fields deliberately omit.

gender.description: Self-reported gender slug (fallback when genderUri unavailable). No BIDS or NWB counterpart; added because sociolinguistic and psycholinguistic work routinely collects it and would otherwise put it in an untyped feature.

genderUri.description: AT-URI of the gender definition node.

genotype.description: Genotype for non-human subjects. NWB Subject.genotype.

handedness.description: Handedness slug (fallback when handednessUri unavailable). BIDS participants.tsv handedness, a near-universal inclusion criterion in neurolinguistic work.

handednessScore.description: Laterality quotient scaled to per mille, so an Edinburgh Handedness Inventory score of -100.0 to +100.0 becomes -1000 to 1000.

handednessUri.description: AT-URI of the handedness definition node.

hearingStatus.description: Hearing status slug (fallback when the Uri is unavailable). No BIDS or NWB counterpart; load-bearing for sign language and speech perception research, where it is a defining participant variable.

hearingStatusUri.description: AT-URI of the hearing status definition node.

knowledgeRefs.description: External grounding: ncbi-taxonomy for species, rrid for strain. MUST NOT carry an ORCID or any identifier resolving to a named human, which is what distinguishes this field from every other knowledgeRefs field in the lexicon.

languageProfiles.description: Per-language background, each a pub.layers.acquisition.defs#languageCompetence. A bare BCP-47 array cannot distinguish an L1 Finnish speaker with late L2 English from a simultaneous bilingual, and that distinction is the point of most of the research this record serves.

languageRefs.description: Structured language references complementing languages, each a pub.layers.defs#languageRef. Carries a variety below the language level and grounding of a languoid whose identity is contested, which a bare BCP-47 tag cannot. No array-level cap; the record size limit governs.

languages.description: Canonical BCP-47 tags this participant produced or comprehended data in, including sign language tags. A flat facet for filtering; languageProfiles carries the structure. No array-level cap, since a multilingual consultant's repertoire has no natural bound; the record size limit governs.

metadata.description: Provenance: who created this participant record, with what tool.

participantId.description: Pseudonymous identifier, stable within the authoring repo and meaningless outside it (sub-01, P17). BIDS participant_id, REQUIRED and the first column of participants.tsv. MUST NOT be a name, an e-mail address, a DID, a handle, an institutional identifier, a worker-platform identifier that resolves to an account, or any string derived from a birth date.

sex.description: Biological sex as recorded by the study (fallback when sexUri unavailable). BIDS participants.tsv sex; NWB Subject.sex. Deliberately distinct from gender, because collapsing them is both scientifically and ethically wrong.

sexUri.description: AT-URI of the sex definition node.

species.description: Species slug (fallback when speciesUri unavailable). BIDS participants.tsv species, which expects an NCBI Taxonomy binomial; NWB Subject.species. Ground the binomial through knowledgeRefs with source ncbi-taxonomy rather than minting Layers-local nodes.

speciesUri.description: AT-URI of the species definition node. Grounded through knowledgeRefs with source ncbi-taxonomy rather than a Layers-local vocabulary.

strainRef.description: Strain for non-human subjects, grounded via rrid. BIDS strain_rrid; NWB Subject.strain. No free-text twin: two encodings of one fact with no precedence rule is a conflict waiting to be written.

visionStatus.description: Vision status slug (fallback when the Uri is unavailable). Relevant to eye-tracking and reading studies, where corrected-to-normal is a routine inclusion criterion and correction type affects tracker performance.

visionStatusUri.description: AT-URI of the vision status definition node.

weightGrams.description: Body weight in grams. NWB Subject.weight, kilograms upstream. Primarily an animal-work field; for humans it is a quasi-identifier in small samples and is usually better omitted.

access.description: Conditions under which this session's data may be obtained.

clock.description: What t=0 means (fallback when clockUri unavailable). Every stream offset and every anchor into this session is measured from it, so leaving it implicit would make every cross-stream anchor ambiguous.

clockUri.description: AT-URI of the session clock definition node.

consent.description: Session-level consent when it differs from the participants' standing consent. Absent means the participants' declarations govern.

createdAt.description: When this session record was created.

devices.description: Instruments used, structured rather than a free-text device string; each a pub.layers.defs#deviceInfo.

environment.description: Recording environment slug (fallback when environmentUri unavailable). Determines what a consumer may assume about noise floor, lighting and electromagnetic interference.

environmentUri.description: AT-URI of the recording environment definition node.

eprintRefs.description: AT-URIs of eprint records describing or associated with this session.

ethicsApprovals.description: Human-subjects or animal-care approvals this session was conducted under, each a pub.layers.defs#ethicsApproval (the shared def, reused rather than a bespoke shape). BIDS EthicsApprovals is an optional array of free-text strings upstream.

experimentRef.description: AT-URI of the pub.layers.judgment.experimentDef this session instantiates. An experimentDef is a type-level protocol; a session is the token event that ran it, and 0.8.0 has only the type level.

features.description: Protocol deviations, timestamp coarsening, surgery, pharmacology, stimulus notes. NWB protocol, surgery, virus, pharmacology, data_collection and stimulus_notes land here until any earns a typed field.

knowledgeRefs.description: Knowledge graph references for this session (task grounded via cognitive-atlas, site via ror).

languageRefs.description: Structured language references complementing languages, each a pub.layers.defs#languageRef. No array-level cap; the record size limit governs.

languages.description: Canonical BCP-47 tags this session's data covers, including sign language tags. No array-level cap; the record size limit governs.

licensing.description: Governs the artifact; consent governs the person; access governs the gate.

masterStream.description: The stream whose clock defines t=0, when clock is master-stream-start. An objectRef whose recordRef is this session and whose objectId is the stream uuid.

metadata.description: Provenance: who created this session record, with what tool.

participantRefs.description: AT-URIs of the pub.layers.acquisition.participant records recorded. An array because dialogue, interview, map-task and elicitation sessions have several, and each stream may belong to a different one.

presentation.description: How stimuli were displayed, including screen geometry, which gaze-on-screen eye-tracking requires and which BIDS places in the events sidecar StimulusPresentation object rather than on the tracker.

reproducibility.description: How the acquisition was driven computationally, plus funding, via the shared reproducibilityInfo shape. Session-level ethics approvals are carried by ethicsApprovals. BIDS Funding is a free-text string array upstream.

runs.description: Sub-divisions of the session. BIDS run-<index>, an uninterrupted repetition of data acquisition with the same acquisition parameters and task. A session routinely spans several runs and, per BIDS Motion, several tracking systems at different sampling rates, which is why a session cannot carry one sampling rate.

sessionId.description: Stable session identifier within the authoring repo (ses-01, buckeye-s01-b03). BIDS session_id, REQUIRED in sessions.tsv; NWB session_id.

siteRef.description: Institution or site, grounded via ror. Not an at-uri: an institution is an external entity Layers references, not a Layers record. NWB institution and lab.

startedAt.description: Acquisition start. BIDS sessions.tsv and scans.tsv acq_time; NWB session_start_time, required there. MAY be coarsened for de-identification; when it is, say so in features, because a consumer cannot otherwise distinguish a coarsened timestamp from a precise one.

streams.description: The synchronized media streams making up this session. Inline rather than an edge record because a session is authored by one party who controls all its streams, the same reasoning that makes resource.templateComposition.members inline while corpus.membership is a record.

task.description: Task slug (fallback when taskUri unavailable). BIDS TaskName is REQUIRED in every EEG, MEG, iEEG and NIRS sidecar, yet 0.8.0's only task construct is judgment.experimentDef, reachable only from judgmentSet.experimentRef, so a neural recording with no behavioural judgments could not name what the participant was doing.

taskUri.description: AT-URI of the task definition node; ground to the Cognitive Atlas through knowledgeRefs where possible.

languageRefs.description: Structured language references for this record, grounding each language via glottolog, iso639-3, or cldr and carrying script, region, variety, and role. Richer companion to the languages tag array.

languages.description: BCP-47 language tags this record covers. Empty when language is unspecified or unknown.

licensing.description: Licensing terms governing this annotation layer (supports dual/multi/component licensing).

mediaRefs.description: AT-URIs of the media records (pub.layers.media.media) this layer annotates. Plural because expression is singular, so a layer over several synchronized streams needs more than one target.

simultaneousWithRefs.description: AT-URIs of annotationLayer records whose annotations are co-temporal with this one by construction; for instance the dominant and non-dominant hand tiers of a two-handed sign are one event.

clusters.description: The equivalence classes in this set; each cluster groups annotations judged to corefer.

corpusRef.description: Corpus these clusters span (for cross-document clustering).

AnnotationDefsAnnotation.description: A single abstract annotation. The fields populated depend on the layer's kind/subkind. For token-tags: tokenIndex + label. For spans: anchor + label. For trees: anchor + label + parentId/childIds. For relations: anchor + arguments. For graphs: anchor + arguments or headIndex/targetIndex. This single type replaces the former tag, spanAnnotation, entityMention, situationMention, dependencyArc, parseNode, etc.

anchor.description: How this annotation attaches to the source data.

arguments.description: Role/argument fillers for predicate-argument structures (FrameNet, PropBank, AMR, etc.). Each argument references another annotation.

childIds.description: Child annotation UUIDs in tree structures.

features.description: Open-ended features. Use for domain-specific properties: phraseType, polarity, modality, tense, isEnhanced, morphological features, etc.

headIndex.description: Head/governor token index for directed arcs (dependency parsing). -1 for root.

knowledgeRefs.description: Links to external knowledge bases.

label.description: The primary label (POS tag, entity type, frame name, constituent label, dependency relation, etc.).

ontologyTypeRef.description: Reference to a type definition in a pub.layers.ontology.

parentId.description: Parent annotation in tree structures (constituency, RST, etc.).

spatial.description: Structured spatial annotation. For spatial-expression and location-mention subkinds. Subsumes ISO-Space place annotations (ISO 24617-7), SpatialML PLACE elements, and GeoJSON/WKT geometries.

targetIndex.description: Dependent/target token index for directed arcs.

temporal.description: Structured temporal annotation. For temporal-expression, temporal-value, and temporal-vagueness subkinds. Subsumes TimeML TIMEX3 and OWL-Time GeneralDateTimeDescription.

text.description: Surface text of the annotated span.

tokenIndex.description: For token-level annotations: 0-based index into the tokenization.

uuid.description: Stable identifier for this annotation, used as the referent for parentId, childIds, and argument targets.

value.description: Secondary value (lemma form, gloss, normalized temporal value, etc.).

AnnotationDefsArgumentRef.description: A role/argument reference in a predicate-argument structure. Uses the composable objectRef to point to another annotation, either locally (same layer, by UUID) or remotely (cross-layer or cross-record, by AT-URI + UUID).

features.description: Open-ended features for this argument (e.g., syntactic realization, optionality, span-level attributes).

role.description: The argument role label (e.g., ARG0, Agent, Theme, CAUSE, connective, etc.).

target.description: Reference to the annotation filling this role. Use localId for same-layer, recordRef+objectId for cross-layer.

canonicalLabel.description: The canonical/representative label for this cluster.

knowledgeRefs.description: Links from this cluster to external knowledge bases (e.g., the Wikidata or DBpedia entity the members denote).

members.description: References to the annotations in this cluster. Use localId for same-layer members, recordRef+objectId for cross-layer or cross-document coreference.

access.description: Access conditions on the underlying material (fallback when accessUri unavailable). Distinct from licensing, which states what a recipient may do; this states who may become a recipient, which for participant-identifiable neural, audio and video data is the governing constraint.

accessUri.description: AT-URI of the access-condition definition node (typeDef of 'access-condition' at layers-core.ontology.layers.pub). Refines access; never replaces it.

citation.description: How to cite this collection, and whether this is the level that should be cited. Presence marks this node as citable; creditPolicy delegates upward or downward when it is not.

contents.description: Publisher-declared summary of what this collection contains, one entry per produce type and narrowing. Makes a browse row renderable without paging the produces, which is the difference between a page load and a multi-minute crawl over tens of thousands of annotation records. Every entry states its countSource, so a consumer can tell a declared figure from a computed one and from an absent one. Never authoritative over the appview's computed rollup.

createdAt.description: When this Layers record was written. Distinct from firstReleasedAt and citation.publishedAt, which describe the material rather than the record.

currentVersionRef.description: AT-URI of the release a consumer should treat as current. Written on the concept node; a rollup over a concept node resolves through it.

depth.description: Number of parentRef hops from the root: 0 for a project with no parent, 1 for UD English under UD, 2 for UD English-EWT. Denormalized for indexed subtree queries and, as a side effect, a validity check: a claimed depth that disagrees with the observed chain is how a cycle or a stale parent surfaces. Bounded because a bound is what makes it checkable, not because any depth is meaningful.

description.description: Prose description of what this collection is and what it contains.

embargoedUntil.description: When an embargo lifts, present when access is 'embargoed'.

eprintRefs.description: AT-URIs of pub.layers.eprint.eprint records describing this collection. Inherited by descendants that declare none: one parent eprintRef is what lets UniMorph replace 185 redundant per-language citations with one.

features.description: Open-ended features that no field above reaches. Not a place to reintroduce a controlled vocabulary as key-value strings.

firstReleasedAt.description: When this collection was first released to the public, which for imported material is decades before the Layers record existed.

kind.description: Collection kind slug. REQUIRED, because a consumer that cannot resolve kindUri, or that has not yet indexed the ontology account, must still be able to render and facet this record. Container-ness is carried here rather than by a separate record type: 'project' and 'language-group' habitually contain other collections, 'treebank' and 'judgment-study' habitually do not, and nothing in the schema enforces the habit.

kindUri.description: AT-URI of the collection kind definition node, a pub.layers.ontology.typeDef of the 'catalog-kind' ontology at layers-core.ontology.layers.pub, or a pub.layers.graph.graphNode. Community-expandable via knowledge graph. Refines kind; never replaces it.

knowledgeRefs.description: External groundings for this collection as an entity: Wikidata for the project, ROR for its home institution, OpenAlex or DOI for its canonical publication, LDC or LINDAT or OpenNeuro or PARADISEC for its deposit elsewhere.

languageRefs.description: Structured language references, present when a bare BCP-47 tag is insufficient: a variety below the language level, a Glottolog languoid, a disputed code, or a per-language role in a parallel or bilingual collection. Each entry's tag SHOULD also appear in languages so consumers filtering on the cheap array are not silently excluded.

languages.description: Canonical BCP-47 language tags this collection covers. Canonical means the shortest ISO 639 code that exists for the language: 'en' not 'eng', 'fi' not 'fin', but 'poma' for Pomak because no 639-1 code exists. Language is a FACET, never a level: 107 of UD's 145 languages have exactly one treebank, so a language tier would insert 107 nodes identical to their sole child, and 88 treebanks sit in cross-language families that a language tier cannot address at any depth. Rolls up as a set union over the containment spine, so a project node legitimately carries 145 tags. Where a tag cannot name the variety precisely, carry the tag here and the precise identity in languageRefs.

licensing.description: Licensing terms governing this collection (supports dual, multi, composite and component-scoped licensing). Component-scoped licensing is the normal case in a nested catalogue: a per-treebank license sits beneath a release-level one, which is what licenseRef.appliesTo carries.

localId.description: Stable, lowercase, immutable, human-readable local identifier for this collection within its publishing account ('ewt', 'eng', 'ud'). Survives handle changes, account merges and record rebuilds, which AT-URIs do not when a repo is rebuilt in place. Advisory for resolution and authoritative for nothing; parentRef is the link.

metadata.description: Provenance: who curated this collection record, under what persona, with what tool, and what upstream records it was derived from.

name.description: Human-readable name, as the community writes it ('UD English-EWT', 'MegaAcceptability Linking v1').

ontologyRefs.description: AT-URIs of pub.layers.ontology.ontology records defining the type systems used across this collection.

parentRef.description: AT-URI of the pub.layers.catalog.collection that contains this one. Child-held and single-valued: a child's PDS can always write this, whereas nothing can compel a parent's PDS to write a member array, so this is the canonical containment spine and a parent-held member list would be a derived cache at best. MUST NOT be self-referential directly or transitively; the appview rejects cycles at index time. A collection has at most one parent and may be a member of any number of collections through pub.layers.catalog.membership.

pinPolicy.description: Whether this collection's membership is pinned to exact member revisions or tracks them as they change. Declared rather than enforced, because the declaration is what a consumer needs and enforcement across repos it does not own is not available. Under 'pinned', every pub.layers.catalog.membership edge into this collection SHOULD carry memberCid, and the appview flags those that do not. Layers-hosted collections whose repos are rebuilt in place SHOULD declare 'floating' and carry the release axis in version plus previousVersionRef, since a rebuild moves every CID and dangles every pin taken before it.

pinPolicyUri.description: AT-URI of the pin-policy definition node (typeDef of 'pin-policy' at layers-core.ontology.layers.pub). Refines pinPolicy; never replaces it.

previousVersionRef.description: AT-URI of the collection release this one directly supersedes, forming a version chain. Distinct from a sibling work: four MegaAttitude datasets share one project and only one of them is a version of another.

releasedAt.description: When this particular version was released.

reproducibility.description: How this collection was built: pipeline name and version, container, code repository, commit, command, funding and ethics approvals. Required in spirit for any collection derived from another, since nesting produces derivatives by construction.

rootRef.description: AT-URI of the root of this collection's parent chain, denormalized so subtree selection is an indexed equality rather than a recursive chase. Equal to this record's own AT-URI when parentRef is absent, which cannot be written into the record and is therefore left absent at depth 0.

stability.description: Lifecycle state of this collection (fallback when stabilityUri unavailable).

stabilityNotice.description: Prose explaining a deprecation or withdrawal, and where to go instead.

stabilityUri.description: AT-URI of the stability definition node (typeDef of 'stability' at layers-core.ontology.layers.pub). Refines stability; never replaces it.

supersededByRef.description: AT-URI of the collection that replaces this one after a withdrawal or a rename. Distinct from previousVersionRef's inverse: supersession may cross project boundaries.

version.description: Version or release designation of this collection ('2.18', 'v2.1', 'FrameNet 1.7'). Present on a release node; usually absent on the concept node above it.

versionOfRef.description: AT-URI of the concept-level collection this record is a released version OF. Version is orthogonal to containment: a release is a versionOf its concept node, NEVER a child of it. UD has 24 releases; were a release a child and release edges summed, UD would report 24 times 228 treebanks. Rollups on a concept node resolve through currentVersionRef and sum that release only.

CatalogDefsCitation.description: How to cite this collection, and whether this collection is the level that should be cited at all. A collection carrying a citation block is a citable node: a publisher declaration rather than a schema tier, which is what lets UD name the treebank as citable while UniMorph names the project. Absent means the publisher has not declared; consumers should fall back to the nearest ancestor that has.

acknowledgement.description: Acknowledgement text the publisher asks downstream users to reproduce.

authors.description: Authors or maintainers credited for this collection, as agentRefs so an ORCID grounds a person and a DID grounds an ATProto-native contributor. Structured rather than a name string because release-level deposits routinely flatten hundreds of contributors into 'Zeman, Daniel; et al.', and the project node and the release node legitimately carry different author sets.

citeAs.description: The publisher's preferred citation string, as prose. Prose by design: this is the residue after authors, publisher and identifiers have been given structurally, and forcing a bibliography style into a schema would be false precision.

creditPolicy.description: Where the publisher wants credit to land (fallback when creditPolicyUri unavailable). 'cite-self' marks this node as the row a bibliography should name, which is UniMorph's case: 186 language datasets share one paper. 'cite-children' delegates downward, which is UD's case: researchers cite the treebank, not the project. 'cite-both' is legitimate when a project paper and a component paper both exist. Umbrella collections SHOULD default to 'cite-children' so that a duplicate citable level is authored deliberately rather than by omission.

creditPolicyUri.description: AT-URI of the credit-policy definition node (typeDef of 'credit-policy' at layers-core.ontology.layers.pub). Refines creditPolicy; never replaces it.

identifiers.description: Persistent identifiers for this collection, grounded via source 'doi', 'handle', 'islrn', 'datacite', 'openalex' or 'ror'. This is the field that gives a persistent identifier to the level researchers actually name, which today is a directory inside a tarball under someone else's handle.

publishedAt.description: Publication date used in a citation. Distinct from createdAt, which is when the Layers record was written.

publisher.description: The publishing organization or repository, grounded via source 'ror', 'lindat', 'ldc', 'elra', 'openneuro' or 'wikidata'. Not a free-text name: 'LDC', 'Linguistic Data Consortium' and 'U. Penn LDC' are one organization and must facet as one.

CatalogDefsContentSummary.description: One publisher-declared bucket of what a collection contains: a produce record type, optionally narrowed by kind, subkind and modality, with a count and an explicit statement of where the count came from. Exists so a browse row can state 'sentence-level dependency annotation over 16,622 expressions, English, gold' without paging tens of thousands of annotation records. Never authoritative over the appview's computed rollup; countSource is what lets a consumer tell the two apart.

asOf.description: When this summary was last recomputed by its publisher. A stale summary is detectable only if it is dated.

count.description: How many units this bucket holds. Meaningless without countSource: pub.layers.corpus.corpus.expressionCount is null on every live record today, and a rollup that cannot distinguish a declared 16,622 from a computed 16,622 from an absent one will present zero as fact.

countIsExact.description: Whether count is exact rather than rounded or floored. Absent means unstated.

countSource.description: Where count came from. Required, because an unqualified number in a catalogue is a claim the catalogue cannot support. 'declared' is the publisher's own figure; 'computed' is derived from records the publisher holds; 'estimated' is sampled or projected; 'unavailable' asserts the bucket exists while its size is unknown, which is the honest state for most of the live corpus today.

countSourceUri.description: AT-URI of the count-source definition node (typeDef of 'count-source' at layers-core.ontology.layers.pub). Refines countSource; never replaces it.

exampleRefs.description: AT-URIs of a few representative records from this bucket, so a browse row can render a real example without a query. Advisory and small by design.

features.description: Open key-value map for publisher-specific summary attributes not covered by the named fields.

formalism.description: Annotation formalism slug (fallback when formalismUri unavailable).

formalismUri.description: AT-URI of the formalism definition node (typeDef of 'formalism' at layers-annotation.ontology.layers.pub). Refines formalism; never replaces it.

kind.description: Kind slug (fallback when kindUri unavailable). Draws on the kind vocabulary of the record type named by produceCollection, so its value space is polymorphic by construction. A consumer that cannot resolve produceCollection MUST render this slug verbatim rather than attempting to validate it.

kindUri.description: AT-URI of the kind definition node for this bucket. MUST resolve into the kind vocabulary of the record type named by produceCollection: a pub.layers.ontology.typeDef of the 'annotation-kind' ontology at layers-annotation.ontology.layers.pub for an annotationLayer bucket, of 'catalog-kind' at layers-core.ontology.layers.pub for a nested collection bucket. Refines kind; never replaces it.

languages.description: Canonical BCP-47 language tags this bucket covers, when narrower than the collection's own languages array. Canonical means the shortest ISO 639 code that exists for the language: 'en' not 'eng', 'fi' not 'fin', but 'poma' for Pomak because no 639-1 code exists.

modality.description: Modality slug (fallback when modalityUri unavailable). Covers everything Layers can annotate, not text alone.

modalityUri.description: AT-URI of the modality definition node, a pub.layers.ontology.typeDef of the 'modality' ontology at layers-core.ontology.layers.pub. The SAME node set is named by pub.layers.judgment.defs#recordingMethod.methodUri and by pub.layers.media.defs#signalInfo.modalityUri, so a recording, the experiment that produced it, and the catalogue entry advertising it join on one vocabulary. Distinct from pub.layers.media.media.kindUri, which names the CARRIER: each modality node reaches its carrier node by parentTypeRef, so 'collections with EEG' and 'media of kind signal' are one traversal rather than two enums.

produceCollection.description: NSID of the produce record type this bucket summarizes. Takes the same value space as pub.layers.catalog.defs#memberRef.memberType so a summary and an edge over the same produce join without translation.

sourceMethod.description: How the contents of this bucket were produced (fallback when sourceMethodUri unavailable). This is the gold-versus-silver discriminator and the single most requested filter in corpus browsing.

sourceMethodUri.description: AT-URI of the production-method definition node (typeDef of 'source-method' at layers-annotation.ontology.layers.pub). Refines sourceMethod; never replaces it.

subkind.description: Subkind slug (fallback when subkindUri unavailable). This is the primary selection criterion for corpus and NLP browsing: 'has dependency annotation' and 'has coreference' are subkind queries, and answering them by paging annotationLayer records costs minutes and hundreds of megabytes per refresh.

subkindUri.description: AT-URI of the subkind definition node (typeDef of 'annotation-subkind' at layers-annotation.ontology.layers.pub for annotation buckets). Refines subkind; never replaces it.

unit.description: Unit slug for count (fallback when unitUri unavailable).

unitUri.description: AT-URI of the unit definition node (typeDef of 'unit' at layers-core.ontology.layers.pub). Refines unit; never replaces it.

CatalogDefsMemberRef.description: A reference to the thing contained by a collection. Composes pub.layers.defs#objectRef rather than re-declaring recordRef and objectId, so a member that exists only in an external knowledge base (a VerbNet class present in Wikidata but not yet in Layers) is representable, and so any resolver written against objectRef works here unchanged.

memberCid.description: CID of the exact member revision this edge pins. Required in practice when the containing collection declares pinPolicy 'pinned'. Pins the member's RECORD, not its contents: a corpus record's expressions and annotation layers live in other repos reached through pub.layers.corpus.membership, which this CID does not cover. Pin the produce edges too for layer-set coverage; byte-level reproducibility is not implied.

memberName.description: Display cache of the member's name, advisory in exactly the way an ATProto handle is advisory. Lets a container render a member list before its members are indexed; superseded by the member record whenever it resolves.

memberType.description: NSID of the member's record type, denormalized so a member list can dispatch its renderer and filter by type without resolving every AT-URI. Mirrors the NSID-discriminator pattern of pub.layers.changelog.entry#subjectCollection. Empty string when the member is knowledgeRef-only.

memberVersion.description: Display cache of the member's version string. Advisory; superseded by the member record whenever it resolves.

ref.description: The member. Populate recordRef for a Layers record, recordRef plus objectId for a sub-record object, knowledgeRef for a member Layers does not hold.

CatalogGetCollectionCollectionView.description: A collection as it appears in a browse row: the record, its identity, and the two derived numbers a card needs.

cid.description: CID of this collection's current revision.

descendantCollectionCount.description: Number of collections in this one's subtree along the containment spine.

uri.description: AT-URI of this collection.

ancestors.description: The parentRef chain, root first. Empty when this collection is a root.

children.description: Collections whose parentRef points at this one, ordered by ordinal then name. Truncated at the page limit; use listMembers for the full set.

cid.description: CID of the returned collection's current revision.

descendantCollectionCount.description: Number of collections in this one's subtree along the containment spine, computed by the appview. 0 for a leaf, which is what lets a ragged hierarchy render uniformly: every child is a card and the count says whether it opens.

pinnedUri.description: The pinned citation form: this record's AT-URI together with the CID under which the appview resolved it. Computed at read time, because a record cannot carry its own CID: writing the value would change it.

uri.description: AT-URI of the returned collection.

CatalogGetRollupFacet.description: One facet dimension and its buckets.

dimension.description: Facet dimension slug (fallback when dimensionUri unavailable).

dimensionUri.description: AT-URI of the facet dimension definition node (typeDef of 'facet-dimension' at layers-core.ontology.layers.pub). Refines dimension; never replaces it.

values.description: The buckets within this dimension, one per distinct value with its member count.

CatalogGetRollupFacetValue.description: One bucket within a facet. Merging is one-directional: a record carrying valueUri N and a record carrying only the slug of N merge into one bucket keyed on N, while two records pointing at DIFFERENT nodes that happen to share a fallback slug do not merge. That asymmetry is the whole reason the URI half of the pair exists.

count.description: Number of distinct members contributing this value, deduplicated by member AT-URI so a member reachable by several paths counts once.

label.description: Display label resolved from the definition node, when one resolved.

value.description: Slug for this bucket. Rendered verbatim when it falls outside the field's knownValues: an off-vocabulary slug is meaningful data, and coercing it to 'custom' or discarding it loses real distinctions that publishers have already drawn.

valueUri.description: AT-URI of the definition node this bucket is keyed on, when the bucket resolved to one.

collection.description: AT-URI of the collection this rollup was computed over.

computedAt.description: When this rollup was computed. A rollup without a timestamp cannot be told from a stale cache.

descendantCollectionCount.description: Number of collections in the subtree along the containment spine, each counted once.

facets.description: Facet buckets over the reachable graph.

totals.description: Summed content buckets over the subtree, each carrying its own countSource: 'computed' where the appview counted the records, 'declared' where it could only add up publishers' own figures, and 'unavailable' where a bucket is known to exist at an unknown size. A subtree mixing the three reports the weakest, so a total is never presented as firmer than its inputs.

warnings.description: What the rollup could not establish. Reported rather than silently absorbed, since a hierarchy over unpopulated fields otherwise renders as confident zeroes.

CatalogGetRollupRollupWarning.description: A qualification on a computed rollup.

code.description: Warning code slug (fallback when codeUri unavailable).

codeUri.description: AT-URI of the warning-code definition node (typeDef of 'rollup-warning' at layers-core.ontology.layers.pub). Refines code; never replaces it.

detail.description: Prose explaining what the warning code means for this particular subject.

subjectRef.description: AT-URI of the record the warning concerns.

cursor.description: Opaque pagination cursor to pass to the next call; absent when the last page has been reached.

records.description: The page of matching collections, as browse rows.

cid.description: CID of the membership edge's current revision.

container.description: The collection at the container end, resolved.

contributesToRollup.description: Whether this edge's role is one of the two that sum ('member', 'produce'). False for every cross-family relation, which is what keeps a parallel-corpus grouping browsable while contributing zero to the counts of treebanks it does not own.

uri.description: AT-URI of the membership edge.

cursor.description: Opaque pagination cursor to pass to the next call; absent when the last page has been reached.

parent.description: The member's canonical parent, resolved from its own parentRef rather than from any edge. Returned separately because it is the one containment fact the member itself asserts, and it is the only one that contributes to a subtree sum.

records.description: Edges pointing at this member, each with its asserting collection resolved.

CatalogListMembersMembershipView.description: A membership edge together with the resolved member's identity, so a member list renders without a second round trip.

cid.description: CID of the membership edge's current revision.

memberCidResolved.description: CID at which the member actually resolved. Differs from the edge's memberCid when a pin is dangling, which is how a rebuilt repo's moved CIDs become visible rather than silent.

memberCollectionValue.description: The member record itself when it is a nested collection, so a child list renders in one call.

memberResolved.description: Whether the appview holds the member record. False is a normal state, not an error: an edge into an unindexed or third-party PDS renders from the edge's own memberName and memberVersion display caches.

uri.description: AT-URI of the membership edge.

cursor.description: Opaque pagination cursor to pass to the next call; absent when the last page has been reached.

records.description: The page of membership edges out of this collection, each with its resolved member.

catalogRef.description: AT-URI of the pub.layers.catalog.collection at the container end of this edge.

createdAt.description: Timestamp when this membership edge record was created.

eprintRefs.description: AT-URIs of pub.layers.eprint.eprint records documenting this relation.

features.description: Open key-value map for edge-specific attributes not covered by the named fields.

knowledgeRefs.description: External groundings for the relation itself, such as the paper that established a derivation or an alignment.

member.description: The thing at the other end, as an objectRef plus a denormalized NSID and optional pinning CID. Covers Layers records, sub-record objects, and members Layers does not hold.

metadata.description: Provenance: who asserted this edge, under what persona, with what tool.

notes.description: Prose qualifying this edge: what was projected, what was excluded, what is approximate.

ordinal.description: Ordering index within the container, when the container has a meaningful order (a release sequence, a paradigm ordering, a curriculum). Absent means unordered.

pinPolicy.description: Pin policy for this edge specifically, overriding the container's declaration. Present because one collection legitimately pins some members and floats others: a release pins the treebanks it shipped while floating the ontology it types against.

pinPolicyUri.description: AT-URI of the pin-policy definition node (typeDef of 'pin-policy' at layers-core.ontology.layers.pub). Refines pinPolicy; never replaces it.

role.description: What this edge asserts. REQUIRED, and it is the field that decides arithmetic. Exactly two roles contribute to a rollup: 'produce', which names a corpus, annotation layer, segmentation, alignment, judgment set, media item or ontology this collection publishes and is where the count recursion bottoms out, and 'member', which names a nested collection whose own parentRef points back here and which therefore lies on the containment spine. Every other role is rendered and never summed, so PropBank-SRL over UD English-EWT appears on the treebank's page under 'annotated by' contributing zero, and a parallel-corpus grouping browses as first-class without inflating the counts of treebanks it does not own.

roleUri.description: AT-URI of the membership role definition node, a pub.layers.ontology.typeDef of the 'membership-role' ontology at layers-core.ontology.layers.pub, or a pub.layers.graph.graphNode. Community-expandable via knowledge graph. Refines role; never replaces it.

selfAsserted.description: True when the edge's author does not control the member, which is the normal case for 'annotates', 'derived-from' and 'parallel-with'. Consumers that surface only curated structure filter on it; consumers that surface everything render it with attribution to the edge's repo.

validFrom.description: When this membership took effect. Lets two releases of one collection carry different member sets as coexisting edges rather than as a rewritten array.

validUntil.description: When this membership ceased. A member dropped between releases is expressed by closing its edge, not by deleting it, so a pinned earlier release still resolves.

ChangelogDefsChangeItem.description: An individual change entry. The targets field uses objectRef for machine-readable sub-record targeting, allowing a change item to point at specific objects within the subject record.

fieldPath.description: Path to the changed field within the target (e.g., 'annotations/3/label', 'formalism', 'annotationDesign/guidelinesRef').

newValue.description: New value as a display string.

previousValue.description: Previous value as a display string.

targets.description: Specific objects that changed. Uses recordRef + objectId for sub-record targeting (e.g., a specific annotation within an annotation layer).

items.description: Individual change items in this section.

createdAt.description: When this changelog entry was created.

subject.description: AT-URI of the record this changelog describes (any pub.layers.* record).

subjectCollection.description: The NSID of the subject record's collection (e.g., 'pub.layers.annotation.annotationLayer'). Enables efficient filtering by record type without resolving the AT-URI.

cid.description: CID of the returned changelog entry record at this revision.

uri.description: AT-URI of the returned changelog entry record.

domainUri.description: AT-URI of the domain definition node. Community-expandable via knowledge graph.

eprintRefs.description: Eprint records (papers/preprints) describing or associated with this corpus.

expressionCount.description: Number of expressions in the corpus.

languageRefs.description: Structured language references for this record, grounding each language via glottolog, iso639-3, or cldr and carrying script, region, variety, and role. Richer companion to the languages tag array.

languages.description: BCP-47 language tags this record covers. Empty when language is unspecified or unknown.

licensing.description: Licensing terms governing this corpus (supports dual/multi/component licensing).

reproducibility.description: How this corpus was produced (code, commit, command, environment, seed).

version.description: Version identifier for this release of the corpus.

CorpusDefsAdjudicationSpec.description: How disagreements between annotators are resolved into a final annotation.

agreementThreshold.description: Agreement level (0-1000) above which adjudication is skipped.

dedicatedAdjudicator.description: Whether a separate adjudicator (not one of the annotators) resolves disagreements.

annotatorPool.description: Total number of annotators in the project.

assignmentStrategy.description: How annotators are assigned to items (fallback when assignmentStrategyUri unavailable).

features.description: Open-ended features for this redundancy specification (e.g., overlap sampling, batch size).
