records.description: The page of membership records returned.

cid.description: CID of this membership record at this revision.

uri.description: AT-URI of this membership record.

corpusRef.description: AT-URI of the corpus this expression belongs to.

createdAt.description: Timestamp when this membership record was created.

expressionRef.description: AT-URI of the expression that is a member of the corpus.

features.description: Open-ended features for this membership (e.g., source file, import batch, quality flags).

metadata.description: Provenance: who assigned this expression to this corpus, when, with what tool.

splitUri.description: AT-URI of the split definition node. Community-expandable via knowledge graph.

DefsAccessCondition.description: How the referenced bytes may actually be obtained. 0.8.0 carries licensing but no gate: it can say a corpus is LDC-User-Agreement licensed but not that obtaining it requires a signed agreement with a named body. Layers DECLARES access conditions and cannot ENFORCE them, because every record it indexes lives in someone else's PDS; the block exists so a consumer knows where the gate is before wasting a request.

agreementUri.description: The data use agreement or end-user licence that must be signed.

applicationUri.description: URL of the access application or registration form.

embargoedUntil.description: When an embargo lifts, when mode is embargoed.

gatekeeperRef.description: The body that grants access, grounded via ror or wikidata (an archive, a data access committee, a consortium).

mode.description: Access mode slug (fallback when modeUri unavailable).

modeUri.description: AT-URI of the access mode definition node (typeDef of access-condition at layers-core.ontology.layers.pub).

notes.description: Free-text access detail the typed fields do not capture.

permittedUse.description: What the access grant permits (fallback when the Uri is unavailable). Distinct from the licence: some agreements permit analysis but forbid redistribution or model training regardless of licence.

permittedUseUri.description: AT-URI of the permitted-use definition node.

DefsAgentRef.description: A composable reference to any agent (human annotator, ML model, crowd worker, expert panel, etc.) that produced data. Separates the identity of the producer from the interpretive framework (persona) and the software used (tool). Consumers dispatch on which field(s) are populated: did for ATProto-native agents, id for anonymized or platform-specific identifiers, knowledgeRef for externally grounded agents (ORCID, HuggingFace model card, Wikidata).

did.description: ATProto DID of the agent, if the agent has one.

id.description: Arbitrary string identifier (anonymized crowdworker ID, platform username, model version string, etc.).

knowledgeRef.description: External knowledge graph reference for the agent (e.g., ORCID for a human, HuggingFace model card for an ML model, Wikidata for an organization).

name.description: Human-readable display name for the agent.

DefsAlignmentLink.description: A single link in an alignment between two parallel sequences. Maps element(s) in a source sequence to element(s) in a target sequence. Supports many-to-many correspondence for interlinear glossing, parallel text alignment, cross-tokenization mapping, etc.

features.description: Open-ended features of this alignment link not reached by the named fields.

knowledgeRefs.description: Knowledge graph references for this link (e.g., bilingual dictionary entry, translation memory source).

label.description: Optional label for the alignment link (e.g., alignment type).

DefsAnchor.description: Abstract anchor: how an annotation attaches to its source data. This is a polymorphic type; at least one anchoring field should be present. Consumers dispatch on which field(s) are populated.

boundingBox.description: Static spatial region in an image or single frame. Imposes no temporal span; for a region that tracks over time use spatioTemporalAnchor.

externalTarget.description: External resource target (web page, document, etc.).

pageAnchor.description: Page and region in a paged document.

signalSpan.description: Sample-indexed or time-indexed span over one or more channels of a continuous signal (EEG, MEG, audio waveform, sensor stream, etc.).

spatialRegion.description: Normalized spatial region used as an anchor (aliased so anchor-use is distinct from the annotation.spatial content-use of the same type).

textSpan.description: Character-offset span in the expression text.

DefsAnnotationMetadata.description: Metadata about who or what produced an annotation, when, and with what confidence. The three key provenance fields are: agent (who did it), personaRef (under what framework), and tool (with what software).

agent.description: The agent (human or model) that produced this annotation. Distinct from personaRef (the interpretive framework) and tool (the software).

confidence.description: Confidence score scaled 0-1000 (to avoid floats). 1000 = maximum confidence.

contentDigest.description: Structured content hash for integrity verification of this annotation.

dependencies.description: References to upstream records this annotation was derived from.

personaRef.description: Reference to the persona/annotation framework under which this annotation was produced. Distinct from agent (who did it).

tool.description: Name or identifier of the software tool used to produce this annotation (e.g., 'spaCy 3.7', 'brat 1.3', 'ELAN 6.4'). Distinct from agent (who ran the tool). Display fallback when toolRef is unavailable.

toolRef.description: Grounded reference to the software tool, typically via rrid (a Research Resource Identifier). Distinct from agent (who ran the tool).

DefsBoundingBox.description: A spatial bounding box for image or video frame annotation.

frameIndex.description: 0-indexed frame this box lies on, for framed media.

page.description: 0-indexed page this box lies on, for paged media.

scope.description: Which medium, session clock, stream, and track this box is measured against. Absent means the single medium reachable from the annotated expression.

timeNanos.description: Signed time in nanoseconds, session-relative, at which this box applies.

unit.description: Coordinate unit slug (fallback when unitUri unavailable). Absent means pixel.

unitUri.description: AT-URI of the coordinate unit definition node (a unit typeDef under layers-core.ontology.layers.pub). Community-expandable via knowledge graph.

x.description: X coordinate of top-left corner in pixels.

y.description: Y coordinate of top-left corner in pixels.

DefsConstraint.description: An abstract constraint expression. Used for type constraints on role slots, slot-level constraints in templates, cross-slot agreement constraints, and any other declarative restriction. The expression field holds a DSL string whose format is identified by expressionFormat/expressionFormatUri.

context.description: Names of the slots or variables this constraint ranges over (for cross-slot and cross-template constraints).

expressionFormat.description: Expression format slug (fallback when expressionFormatUri unavailable).

expressionFormatUri.description: AT-URI of the expression format definition node. Community-expandable via knowledge graph.

scope.description: Constraint scope slug (fallback when scopeUri unavailable).

scopeUri.description: AT-URI of the scope definition node. Community-expandable via knowledge graph.

DefsContentDigest.description: A structured content hash for integrity verification. Separates the algorithm from the digest value so verifiers dispatch on algorithm rather than parsing a packed string.

algorithm.description: Digest algorithm slug (fallback when algorithmUri unavailable).

algorithmUri.description: AT-URI of the digest algorithm definition node. Community-expandable via knowledge graph.

DefsDeviceInfo.description: An instrument used in acquisition. Manufacturer, product and software are GROUNDED through defs#knowledgeRef rather than enumerated: an organization is a citable entity reachable via ror and wikidata, a package via rrid, and enumerating vendors in a released lexicon makes a rebrand a lexicon version bump. BIDS Manufacturer, ManufacturersModelName, DeviceSerialNumber, SoftwareVersions, SoftwareRRID; NWB Device.

features.description: Open-ended device features not captured by the typed fields.

kind.description: Device kind slug (fallback when kindUri unavailable).

kindUri.description: AT-URI of the device kind definition node (typeDef of `device-kind`). MUST resolve into the same `modality` node set as recordingMethod.methodUri where the two overlap, so an instrument named in a protocol and the same instrument named in a session join.

manufacturerName.description: Display name when no identifier exists. Advisory; manufacturerRef wins.

manufacturerRef.description: Manufacturer, grounded via source ror or wikidata. Replaces a free-text vendor name: MEGIN, Elekta and Elekta/MEGIN are one organization and must facet as one.

model.description: BIDS ManufacturersModelName, as printed on the device.

productRef.description: The product, grounded via rrid where one exists.

serialNumber.description: BIDS DeviceSerialNumber. A serial number can be a de-anonymizing quasi-identifier in a single-site study; omit it when the participant's identifiability is anonymous.

software.description: Acquisition or presentation software, reusing the shared reproducibility block rather than re-declaring softwareName, softwareVersion, codeUri and operatingSystem. BIDS SoftwareVersions and GeneratedBy.

DefsEthicsApproval.description: A reference to an ethics or institutional review board approval covering a piece of work. Shared across acquisition consent, sessions, and reproducibility info.

bodyName.description: Advisory name of the approving board; bodyRef wins where both are present.

bodyRef.description: The approving board, grounded via ror; clinicaltrials for a registered trial.

uri.description: URI of the approval record.

DefsExternalTarget.description: Target for annotating external resources (web pages, documents, etc.). Compatible with at.margin's target model and the W3C Web Annotation Data Model.

selector.description: W3C selector for identifying the specific segment within the resource.

source.description: The URI of the external resource being annotated.

sourceHash.description: SHA256 hash of normalized URI for indexing.

title.description: Title of the resource at annotation time.

value.description: Feature value as string. Consumers may parse typed values based on the key's semantics.

DefsFeatureMap.description: An open-ended set of typed key-value features that can be attached to any annotation. Provides maximum extensibility without committing to any label set or linguistic theory.

DefsFragmentSelector.description: W3C FragmentSelector: selects by URI fragment identifier.

DefsFrequencyBand.description: A frequency band selecting a sub-band of a continuous signal (e.g., an EEG rhythm or a speech formant). Follows the URI+slug pattern; explicit low/high bounds override the slug where present.

band.description: Frequency band slug (fallback when bandUri unavailable).

bandUri.description: AT-URI of the frequency band definition node. Community-expandable via knowledge graph.

highMilliHz.description: Upper bound of the band in millihertz.

lowMilliHz.description: Lower bound of the band in millihertz.

DefsFundingRef.description: A reference to a grant or award that funded a piece of work. Shared across acquisition consent and reproducibility info.

funderRef.description: The funding body, grounded via ror or the Crossref Funder Registry.

title.description: Title of the grant or award.

uri.description: URI of the award record.

DefsKeyframe.description: A spatial annotation at a specific time point.

bbox.description: The spatial bounding box occupied at this time point.

features.description: Per-keyframe features (e.g., visibility, occlusion percentage, confidence, pose data).

DefsKnowledgeRef.description: A reference to an external knowledge base entry. Supports ATProto-native KBs (e.g., chive.pub with AT-URI nodes), external KBs (e.g., Wikidata with QIDs), and user/persona-specific KBs (AT-URIs in user PDSes).

identifier.description: The identifier within the knowledge base (e.g., Wikidata QID, chive.pub node URI, Glottolog languoid ID).

label.description: Human-readable label for the referenced entity.

source.description: Knowledge base source slug (fallback when sourceUri unavailable).

sourceUri.description: AT-URI of the knowledge base type definition node. Community-expandable via knowledge graph.

uri.description: Optional full URI for the knowledge base entry.

DefsLanguageRef.description: A structured reference to a language or language variety, decomposing a BCP-47 tag into its codes plus a knowledge-graph grounding and a role. The tag is the canonical addressable key; importers normalize it on write.

knowledgeRef.description: Grounding of the language, with source glottolog, iso639-3, or cldr.

languageUri.description: AT-URI of the language definition node. Community-expandable via knowledge graph.

regionCode.description: ISO 3166-1 or UN M.49 region code.

role.description: Language-role slug (fallback when roleUri unavailable), naming the role this language plays in the record.

roleUri.description: AT-URI of the language-role definition node (a language-role typeDef under layers-core.ontology.layers.pub). Community-expandable via knowledge graph.

tag.description: Canonical BCP-47 tag using the shortest ISO 639 code (en not eng, fi not fin, poma for Pomak). Importers must normalize on write.

varietyLabel.description: Prose residue naming the variety after every code applies.

DefsLicenseRef.description: Detail for a single license. Follows the URI+slug pattern (spdxUri is the canonical knowledge-graph node, spdx is the human-readable fallback) and mirrors one entry of a DataCite rightsList (rightsIdentifier + rightsURI).

appliesTo.description: Component this license covers when an artifact mixes licenses by part (fallback when appliesToUri unavailable). Omit when the license covers the whole artifact.

appliesToUri.description: AT-URI of the license-component definition node (a license-component typeDef under layers-core.ontology.layers.pub). Community-expandable via knowledge graph.

attribution.description: Required attribution / credit text for downstream users.

name.description: Human-readable license name (e.g., 'Creative Commons Attribution 4.0 International').

notes.description: Additional licensing notes, restrictions, or usage terms.

spdx.description: SPDX license identifier (fallback when spdxUri unavailable). Non-SPDX terms use 'proprietary' or 'custom' and ground the full text via spdxUri/url.

spdxUri.description: AT-URI of the license definition node. Community-expandable via knowledge graph.

url.description: URL of the full license text (DataCite rightsURI).

DefsLicensing.description: Complete licensing terms for a released artifact. Represents single, dual/multi (choose-one), composite (all-apply), exception (WITH), and component-scoped licensing. The SPDX license expression encodes the boolean relationship between licenses; the licenses array carries per-license detail.

expression.description: SPDX license expression encoding the relationship between licenses: OR for dual/multi-licensing (the licensee chooses one), AND for composite terms (all apply), WITH for exceptions. Examples: 'MIT OR Apache-2.0', 'CC-BY-4.0 AND LicenseRef-LDC-User-Agreement'. Optional when a single license applies.

licenses.description: The individual licenses named by the expression, or the single governing license. Each entry may scope itself to a component via appliesTo.

DefsMediaScope.description: Identifies which medium, session clock, stream, and track a sample-indexed or time-indexed anchor is measured against. Absent means the single medium reachable from the annotated expression, which preserves the single-stream reading of records that omit it.

mediaCid.description: CID pinning the exact version of the media record.

mediaRef.description: AT-URI of the pub.layers.media.media record this anchor addresses.

sessionRef.description: AT-URI of the pub.layers.acquisition.session whose clock the sample and nanosecond times are on.

stream.description: The session stream this anchor is on; recordRef is the sessionRef and objectId is the stream uuid (acquisition.defs#stream).

trackIndex.description: 0-indexed track within the medium (e.g., an audio track or a subtitle track).

DefsObjectRef.description: A composable reference to any Layers object, whether local (same record, by UUID), remote (different record, by AT-URI + optional object UUID), or external (knowledge graph entry). This is the universal cross-referencing primitive; consumers dispatch on which field(s) are populated. Used by argumentRef, graphNode, alignment endpoints, and any other cross-object pointer.

knowledgeRef.description: Reference to an external knowledge graph node (Wikidata, chive.pub, FrameNet, etc.).

localId.description: UUID of an object within the same record.

objectId.description: UUID of a specific object within the record referenced by recordRef.

recordRef.description: AT-URI of a Layers record in another user's PDS or another record in the same PDS.

DefsPageAnchor.description: Anchor to a specific page and region in a paged document (PDF, etc.). Compatible with chive.pub's page-level annotation model.

boundingBox.description: Bounding box of the anchored region within the page.

textSpan.description: Character offsets within the page text.

DefsReproducibilityInfo.description: Information about how to reproduce a dataset or the data produced from an eprint. Shared by data-producing produces (corpus, annotation layers, experiments) and eprint data links.

container.description: The container or environment image the procedure ran in.

digest.description: Content digest pinning the exact image.

type.description: Container type slug (fallback when typeUri unavailable).

typeUri.description: AT-URI of the container type definition node. Community-expandable via knowledge graph.

uri.description: URI of the container registry entry or image definition.

environment.description: Environment specification (Docker image, conda env, etc.).

ethicsApprovals.description: Ethics or IRB approvals covering the work producing this data.

funding.description: Grants or awards that funded the work producing this data.

name.description: Human-readable name of the pipeline, model, or procedure that produced the data.

operatingSystem.description: Operating system the procedure ran on.

softwareRefs.description: Grounded references to the software used, typically via rrid (Research Resource Identifiers).

version.description: Version string of the pipeline, model, or procedure.

DefsSignalSpan.description: A span over one or more channels of a continuous signal (EEG, MEG, ECoG, audio waveform, motion or eye-tracking stream). Addressable by sample index or by session-relative nanoseconds; scope is required because an unscoped sample index is meaningless.

channelNames.description: Advisory channel-name fallback; channels wins where both are present.

channels.description: Channels this span covers; each objectRef has recordRef the media record and objectId a signalChannel uuid. Empty or absent means all channels.

endingNanos.description: Signed end on the stream or session clock, session-relative.

frequencyBand.description: Frequency band this span selects, for time-frequency annotation.

region.description: Spatial region this span applies to, reusing the promoted spatial anchor (no separate voxel-region type is introduced).

scope.description: Which medium, session clock, stream, and track the sample and nanosecond indices are measured against. Required.

sensors.description: Sensors this span covers; each objectRef has recordRef the media record and objectId a sensorSpec uuid.

startNanos.description: Signed start on the stream or session clock, session-relative and never UTC-epoch. Authoritative when startSample is absent; startSample wins where both are present.

startSample.description: Inclusive 0-indexed start sample, signed (may precede the clock origin).

volumeIndexEnd.description: Exclusive end volume, for volumetric time series.

volumeIndexStart.description: Inclusive 0-indexed start volume, for volumetric time series (e.g., fMRI runs).

DefsSpan.description: A contiguous span of text defined by UTF-8 byte offsets.

charEnd.description: Exclusive end character offset. Optional; for compatibility with character-offset datasets.

charStart.description: Inclusive start character offset. Optional; for compatibility with character-offset datasets.

DefsSpatialEntity.description: A normalized spatial value representing a point, region, line, or complex geometry. Parallel to temporalEntity. Subsumes GeoJSON geometry types, WKT primitives, and ISO 19107 spatial schema. Consumers dispatch on which fields are populated: bbox only (pixel bounding box), geometry+type (parsed geometry string), geometry+geometryFormat (format-specific parsing).

articulator.description: Articulator slug (fallback when articulatorUri unavailable), naming the body part or articulator this region tracks.

articulatorUri.description: AT-URI of the articulator definition node (an articulator typeDef under layers-annotation.ontology.layers.pub). Community-expandable via knowledge graph.

bbox.description: Structured pixel bounding box (axis-aligned rectangle). The most common case for image/video annotation.

crs.description: Coordinate reference system slug (fallback when crsUri unavailable). Determines how coordinates in geometry/bbox are interpreted.

crsUri.description: AT-URI of the coordinate reference system definition node. Community-expandable via knowledge graph.

dimensions.description: Number of coordinate dimensions (2 for planar, 3 for volumetric/elevation).

features.description: Open-ended features of this spatial value not reached by the named fields.

frameIndex.description: 0-indexed frame this region lies on, for framed media.

geometry.description: Geometry as a string in the format specified by geometryFormat. WKT examples: 'POINT(37.7749 -122.4194)', 'POLYGON((0 0, 100 0, 100 100, 0 100, 0 0))'. GeoJSON example: '{"type":"Point","coordinates":[-122.4194,37.7749]}'. SVG path example: 'M 10 10 L 100 10 L 100 100 Z'. Default format is WKT.

geometryFormat.description: Format of the geometry string (fallback when geometryFormatUri unavailable). Default is WKT.

geometryFormatUri.description: AT-URI of the geometry format definition node. Community-expandable via knowledge graph.

maskMediaRef.description: AT-URI of a pub.layers.media.media record carrying a pixel or voxel mask for this region.

page.description: 0-indexed page this region lies on, for paged media.

parcelRef.description: Reference to an atlas parcel grounding this region (e.g., an Uberon or atlas node).

readingOrder.description: 0-indexed reading order of this region among sibling regions on the same page or surface.

role.description: Spatial-region role slug (fallback when roleUri unavailable), naming what layout or anatomical part this region is.

roleUri.description: AT-URI of the spatial-region role definition node (a role typeDef under layers-annotation.ontology.layers.pub). Community-expandable via knowledge graph.

scope.description: Which medium, session clock, stream, and track this region is measured against. Absent means the single medium reachable from the annotated expression.

sensors.description: Sensors whose positions define this region; each objectRef has recordRef the media record and objectId a sensorSpec uuid.

timeNanos.description: Signed time in nanoseconds, session-relative, at which this region applies.

type.description: Geometry type slug (fallback when typeUri unavailable). For dispatch without parsing the geometry string.

typeUri.description: AT-URI of the geometry type definition node. Community-expandable via knowledge graph.

uncertainty.description: Spatial precision or uncertainty radius as a string with units (e.g., '50m', '10px', '0.001deg'). Units depend on the CRS.

DefsSpatialExpression.description: A complete spatial annotation packaging the expression type, normalized value, modifier, anchoring, and document function. Parallel to temporalExpression. Subsumes ISO-Space place annotations (ISO 24617-7), SpatialML PLACE elements, and general spatial semantic annotation. Attach to annotation objects via the spatial field.

anchorRef.description: What this spatial expression is relative to (e.g., a landmark annotation, a reference location, a trajector). For relative spatial expressions like 'behind the building'.

features.description: Open-ended features of this spatial annotation not reached by the named fields.

function.description: Document function slug (fallback when functionUri unavailable). What role this place plays in the document.

functionUri.description: AT-URI of the document function definition node. Community-expandable via knowledge graph.

type.description: Spatial expression type slug (fallback when typeUri unavailable). Maps to ISO-Space spatial entity types.

typeUri.description: AT-URI of the spatial expression type definition node. Community-expandable via knowledge graph.

DefsSpatialModifier.description: Qualitative modification of a spatial value. Parallel to temporalModifier. Indicates precision, derivation method, or processing applied to a spatial entity.

features.description: Open-ended features of this spatial modifier not reached by the named fields.

mod.description: Spatial modifier slug (fallback when modUri unavailable).

modUri.description: AT-URI of the spatial modifier definition node. Community-expandable via knowledge graph.

DefsSpatioTemporalAnchor.description: Combined spatial and temporal anchor for video annotation with keyframe-based tracking.

interpolation.description: Interpolation mode slug (fallback when interpolationUri unavailable).

interpolationUri.description: AT-URI of the interpolation mode definition node. Community-expandable via knowledge graph.

keyframes.description: Keyframes defining spatial positions at specific times.

temporalSpan.description: The temporal extent over which this spatio-temporal region is tracked.

DefsTemporalEntity.description: A normalized temporal value representing a point, interval, duration, or uncertain range in calendar/clock time. Subsumes OWL-Time TemporalEntity (Instant, Interval, Duration) and TimeML TIMEX3 value. Consumers dispatch on which fields are populated: instant only (point), intervalStart+intervalEnd (bounded interval), duration only (pure duration), earliest+latest (uncertain bounds), recurrence (repeating pattern).

calendar.description: Calendar system slug (fallback when calendarUri unavailable). Maps to OWL-Time TRS (Temporal Reference System).

calendarUri.description: AT-URI of the calendar system definition node. Community-expandable via knowledge graph.

duration.description: Duration as ISO 8601 duration (e.g., 'P3Y', 'PT2H30M', 'P1DT12H'). Maps to OWL-Time hasTemporalDuration.

earliest.description: Lower bound for uncertain or vague times, as ISO 8601 datetime.

features.description: Open-ended features of this temporal value not reached by the named fields.

granularity.description: Temporal granularity slug (fallback when granularityUri unavailable). Maps to OWL-Time unitType.

granularityUri.description: AT-URI of the granularity definition node. Community-expandable via knowledge graph.

instant.description: Point in time as ISO 8601 datetime (e.g., '2024-03-15', '2024-03-15T14:30:00Z'). Maps to OWL-Time Instant.

intervalEnd.description: Interval end as ISO 8601 datetime. Maps to OWL-Time hasEnd.

intervalStart.description: Interval start as ISO 8601 datetime. Maps to OWL-Time hasBeginning.

latest.description: Upper bound for uncertain or vague times, as ISO 8601 datetime.

recurrence.description: ISO 8601 repeating interval (e.g., 'R/P1W' for weekly, 'R5/P1D' for 5 daily repetitions).

DefsTemporalExpression.description: A complete temporal annotation packaging the expression type, normalized value, modifier, anchoring, and document function. Subsumes TimeML TIMEX3 and OWL-Time GeneralDateTimeDescription. Attach to annotation objects via the temporal field.

anchorRef.description: What this temporal expression is relative to (e.g., document creation time, another temporal expression, a situation). Maps to TimeML anchorTimeID.

features.description: Open-ended features of this temporal annotation not reached by the named fields.

function.description: Document function slug (fallback when functionUri unavailable). Maps to TimeML functionInDocument.

functionUri.description: AT-URI of the document function definition node. Community-expandable via knowledge graph.

type.description: Temporal expression type slug (fallback when typeUri unavailable). Maps to TimeML TIMEX3 type.

typeUri.description: AT-URI of the temporal expression type definition node. Community-expandable via knowledge graph.

DefsTemporalModifier.description: Qualitative modification of a temporal value. Subsumes TimeML TIMEX3 mod attribute and OWL-Time DateTimeDescription qualifiers.

features.description: Open-ended features of this temporal modifier not reached by the named fields.

mod.description: Temporal modifier slug (fallback when modUri unavailable). Maps to TimeML TIMEX3 mod.

modUri.description: AT-URI of the temporal modifier definition node. Community-expandable via knowledge graph.

DefsTemporalSpan.description: A temporal span within a media source, defined by start and end times in milliseconds on the referenced session or stream clock. Times are signed and session-relative (they may precede the clock origin, matching BIDS StartTime); they are never UTC-epoch values.

ending.description: End time in milliseconds, signed and session-relative.

endingNanos.description: Exact signed end in nanoseconds, session-relative; authoritative over ending where both are present.

scope.description: Which medium, session clock, stream, and track this span is measured against. Absent means the single medium reachable from the annotated expression.

start.description: Start time in milliseconds, signed and session-relative (may be negative when it precedes the clock origin).

startNanos.description: Exact signed start in nanoseconds, session-relative; authoritative over start where both are present.

DefsTextPositionSelector.description: W3C TextPositionSelector adapted for ATProto: selects by UTF-8 byte offsets. Semantically equivalent to pub.layers.defs#span but named for W3C compatibility with at.margin.

charEnd.description: Ending character position (exclusive). Optional; for compatibility with character-offset datasets.

charStart.description: Starting character position (0-indexed, inclusive). Optional; for compatibility with character-offset datasets.

DefsTextQuoteSelector.description: W3C TextQuoteSelector: selects text by quoting it with surrounding context. Compatible with at.margin.annotation and the W3C Web Annotation Data Model.

DefsTokenRef.description: A reference to a specific token within a tokenization, by index.

tokenIndex.description: 0-based index of the token within its tokenization.

tokenizationId.description: UUID of the tokenization containing the referenced token.

DefsTokenRefSequence.description: A sequence of token references, possibly non-contiguous, within a single tokenization.

anchorTokenIndex.description: Optional head/anchor token index within the sequence.

tokenizationId.description: UUID of the tokenization containing the referenced tokens.

DefsUuid.description: A universally unique identifier for cross-referencing annotation objects.

catalogRef.description: Reference to a pub.layers.catalog.collection record: the browsable dataset artifact this eprint produced or is associated with.

createdAt.description: Timestamp when this data link record was created.

dataKind.description: Data kind slug (fallback when dataKindUri unavailable).

dataKindUri.description: AT-URI of the data kind definition node. Community-expandable via knowledge graph.

description.description: Free-text description of this data link.

eprintDid.description: DID of the eprint author/owner on the publication platform.

eprintUri.description: AT-URI of the eprint on its publication platform.

experimentRefs.description: References to pub.layers.judgment.experimentDef records this eprint produced or describes.

features.description: Open-ended features for this data link as key-value pairs.

paperSection.description: Which section of the paper this data corresponds to (e.g., 'Section 4.2', 'Table 3', 'Appendix A').

reproducibility.description: How this data was produced (code, commit, command, environment, seed).

EprintDefsCitation.description: A bibliographic citation, expressible as a raw formatted string (raw) and/or structured fields following CSL-JSON and DataCite conventions. Consumers prefer the structured fields when present and fall back to raw. Populate at least raw or title.

containerTitle.description: Title of the container: journal, book, or proceedings (CSL 'container-title').

creators.description: Authors, editors, and other creators (CSL name variables; DataCite creators).

knowledgeRefs.description: External grounding for the work or venue (Crossref, OpenAlex, DBLP, Semantic Scholar).

language.description: BCP-47 language tag of the work (CSL 'language').

raw.description: Full formatted citation string (CSL fallback). Sufficient on its own when structured metadata is unavailable.

type.description: CSL-JSON item type slug (fallback when typeUri unavailable).

typeUri.description: AT-URI of the bibliographic type definition node. Community-expandable via knowledge graph.

version.description: Version of the cited artifact (CSL 'version'; DataCite version).

EprintDefsCreator.description: A bibliographic creator (author, editor, etc.). Name parts follow CSL-JSON; nameType and affiliation follow DataCite. ATProto-native creators additionally ground identity via agent (DID) or knowledgeRef (ORCID, ROR, OpenAlex).

agent.description: ATProto-native identity grounding (DID) for the creator, if any.

knowledgeRef.description: External identity grounding (ORCID via source 'orcid', ROR for organizations, OpenAlex author id).

literal.description: Full name as a single string when parts are not separated, or an organization name (CSL 'literal').

nameType.description: Whether the creator is a person or an organization (DataCite nameType; fallback when nameTypeUri unavailable).

nameTypeUri.description: AT-URI of the name-type definition node. Community-expandable via knowledge graph.

role.description: Creator role slug (CSL contributor role / DataCite contributorType; fallback when roleUri unavailable).

roleUri.description: AT-URI of the creator-role definition node. Community-expandable via knowledge graph.

sequence.description: Position of this creator in the creator list (1-based).

EprintDefsDate.description: A date in CSL-JSON style: structured year/month/day and/or a free-form literal. Maps to CSL 'date-parts' (when year/month/day are set) or 'literal'/'raw' (when only literal is set).

literal.description: Free-form date string when structured parts are unavailable (CSL 'literal'/'raw').

season.description: Season when the work was issued (CSL 'season').

annotationRefs.description: References to specific annotation records linked to this eprint.

citation.description: Bibliographic citation for the eprint. Carries rendered metadata (authors, title, venue, year) as a raw string and/or structured CSL-JSON/DataCite fields; eprintIdentifier/eprintIdentifierType remain the canonical link key.

createdAt.description: Timestamp when this eprint link record was created.

eprintIdentifier.description: The eprint identifier (DOI, arXiv ID, ACL Anthology ID, etc.).

eprintIdentifierType.description: Identifier type slug (fallback when eprintIdentifierTypeUri unavailable).

eprintIdentifierTypeUri.description: AT-URI of the identifier type definition node. Community-expandable via knowledge graph.

expressionRefs.description: References to Layers expressions linked to this eprint.

features.description: Open-ended features for this eprint link as key-value pairs.

knowledgeRefs.description: Knowledge graph references (e.g., Wikidata for the venue, DBLP, Semantic Scholar corpus ID).

linkType.description: Link type slug (fallback when linkTypeUri unavailable).

linkTypeUri.description: AT-URI of the link type definition node. Community-expandable via knowledge graph.

platformEprintRefs.description: AT-URIs of the eprint record on its publication platforms (e.g., chive.pub, any ATProto-native publication service). An eprint may be mirrored on multiple platforms.

cid.description: CID of the returned data link record at this revision.

uri.description: AT-URI of the returned data link record.

cid.description: CID of the returned eprint record at this revision.

uri.description: AT-URI of the returned eprint record.

cursor.description: Opaque pagination cursor to pass to the next call, absent when no further pages remain.

records.description: The page of data link records returned.

cid.description: CID of this data link record's indexed revision.

uri.description: AT-URI of this data link record.

cursor.description: Opaque pagination cursor to pass to the next call, absent when no further pages remain.

records.description: The page of eprint records returned.

cid.description: CID of this eprint record's indexed revision.

uri.description: AT-URI of this eprint record.

anchor.description: How this expression attaches to its parent (character span, temporal span, etc.).

createdAt.description: Timestamp when this expression record was created.

eprintRefs.description: Eprint records (papers/preprints) describing or associated with this expression.

features.description: Arbitrary document-level features and metadata.

id.description: A corpus-level unique identifier (headline, URL, document ID, etc.).

kind.description: Expression kind slug (fallback when kindUri unavailable).

kindUri.description: AT-URI of the expression kind definition node. Community-expandable via knowledge graph.

knowledgeRefs.description: References to knowledge base entries relevant to this expression.

languageRefs.description: Grounded language references carrying canonical BCP-47 tag, script/region codes, variety label, and a knowledge-graph source (glottolog, iso639-3, cldr). Richer than the languages slug array; use both.

languages.description: BCP-47 language tags this record covers. Empty when language is unspecified or unknown.

mediaRef.description: Reference to an associated media record (audio, video, image).

MediaDefsAudioInfo.description: Composable audio metadata. Attach to any media record representing audio content: standalone audio files, audio tracks in video, etc.

bitRate.description: Audio bitrate in bits per second.

numberOfSamples.description: Total number of audio samples. Enables sample-accurate alignment.

segmentationRef.description: AT-URI of a pub.layers.segmentation record structuring the transcript.

speakerCount.description: Number of distinct speakers (for spoken language data).

transcriptRef.description: AT-URI of a pub.layers.expression containing the transcript.

MediaDefsCoordinateSystem.description: The frame in which sensor, landmark, or volume coordinates are expressed. BIDS coordsystem.json, which requires a named system plus units and RECOMMENDS FiducialsCoordinates and AnatomicalLandmarkCoordinates. One def for all four use sites, so the four divergent lists the proposals carried collapse to one.

description.description: Free-text note about this coordinate frame.

fiducials.description: Named landmark points defining the frame. BIDS FiducialsCoordinates and AnatomicalLandmarkCoordinates.

referenceImageRef.description: AT-URI of a pub.layers.media.media of kind volume or image this frame is defined against. BIDS IntendedFor, a filesystem path upstream.

spatialAxes.description: Direction code naming the positive direction of X, Y, Z (fallback when spatialAxesUri unavailable). BIDS Motion SpatialAxes. Determines how every coordinate in the record is read, so a consumer that cannot resolve it MUST NOT assume a default.

spatialAxesUri.description: AT-URI of the axis convention definition node (typeDef of `spatial-axes`).

system.description: Coordinate system slug (fallback when systemUri unavailable). Covers the BIDS EEG, MEG and iEEG coordinate system lists plus the stereotaxic spaces used for volumetric data.

systemUri.description: AT-URI of the coordinate system definition node (typeDef of `coordinate-system`). Values MUST agree with pub.layers.defs#spatialEntity.crs.

unit.description: Unit of the stored integer coordinates (fallback when unitUri unavailable). BIDS coordinate units are m, mm or cm, plus pixels for iEEG on a photograph; nanometre is the integer-safe encoding of all three.

unitUri.description: AT-URI of the coordinate unit definition node.

MediaDefsDocumentInfo.description: Composable document/image metadata. Attach to any media record representing scanned documents, manuscripts, printed text, or other page-based media for OCR/HTR annotation workflows.

dpi.description: Scanning resolution in dots per inch (300+ recommended for OCR).

pageCount.description: Number of pages in the document.

writingDirection.description: Primary text direction slug (fallback when writingDirectionUri unavailable).

writingDirectionUri.description: AT-URI of the writing-direction definition node (typeDef of `writing-direction` at layers-core.ontology.layers.pub). Refines writingDirection; never replaces it.

MediaDefsEventCode.description: One trigger code and what it means. Grounds BIDS events.tsv trial_type, a bare string upstream, in a type definition node.

channel.description: The channel this code appears on, when the recording has several trigger lines.

code.description: Integer value written on the trigger channel.

description.description: Free-text note about this trigger code.

knowledgeRef.description: External grounding, for instance a HED tag (source hed) or a Cognitive Atlas concept.

label.description: Condition label as the experimenter spells it.

typeUri.description: AT-URI of the condition or event-type definition node, typically a pub.layers.ontology.typeDef.

MediaDefsEyeTrackingInfo.description: Composable eye-tracking metadata, carried alongside signalInfo. Screen geometry is deliberately absent: the same tracker at a different viewing distance yields different degrees of visual angle, so it is a property of stimulus presentation and lives on pub.layers.judgment.defs#presentationSpec.screen, which is where BIDS puts it (the StimulusPresentation object of the events sidecar).

averageCalibrationErrorMicrodegrees.description: BIDS AverageCalibrationError. Microdegrees because typical values are fractions of a degree.

calibrationType.description: BIDS CalibrationType (fallback when the Uri is unavailable), whose examples are H3 and HV9.

calibrationTypeUri.description: AT-URI of the calibration grid definition node.

eventDetection.description: Algorithm used to derive fixations and saccades (fallback when the Uri is unavailable). Absent means the trace is raw and no events were derived.

eventDetectionUri.description: AT-URI of the fixation and saccade detection algorithm definition node.

method.description: Tracking method slug (fallback when methodUri unavailable). BIDS EyeTrackingMethod, whose documented values include P-CR, DPI and EOG.

methodUri.description: AT-URI of the eye-tracking method definition node.

pupilFitMethod.description: BIDS PupilFitMethod (fallback when the Uri is unavailable).

pupilFitMethodUri.description: AT-URI of the pupil fit method definition node.

recordedEye.description: Which eye was recorded (fallback when recordedEyeUri unavailable). BIDS RecordedEye, REQUIRED for eye-tracking recordings.

recordedEyeUri.description: AT-URI of the recorded-eye definition node.

sampleCoordinateSystem.description: What the x and y samples mean (fallback when the Uri is unavailable). BIDS SampleCoordinateSystem, REQUIRED. gaze-on-screen is the value that makes presentationSpec.screen mandatory.

sampleCoordinateSystemUri.description: AT-URI of the gaze coordinate system definition node.

sampleCoordinateUnit.description: Unit of the gaze samples (fallback when the Uri is unavailable). BIDS SampleCoordinateUnits.

sampleCoordinateUnitUri.description: AT-URI of the gaze sample unit definition node.

MediaDefsFilterSpec.description: One filter applied to a recording. BIDS makes SoftwareFilters REQUIRED and HardwareFilters RECOMMENDED and types both as arbitrary nested JSON, so a consumer cannot today decide whether a recording is admissible for a given analysis without reading prose. Every parameter here is an integer in a named unit.

bandwidthMilliHz.description: Bandwidth of the stage, in millihertz.

centreMilliHz.description: Centre frequency, for notch and bandstop stages, in millihertz.

description.description: Free-text note about this filter stage.

design.description: Filter design slug (fallback when designUri unavailable).

designUri.description: AT-URI of the filter design definition node.

direction.description: Whether the filter introduces phase shift (fallback when directionUri unavailable). Load-bearing for any latency claim about an ERP or evoked component.

directionUri.description: AT-URI of the filter direction definition node.

highCutoffMilliHz.description: Low-pass cutoff of this filter stage, in millihertz.

lowCutoffMilliHz.description: High-pass cutoff of this filter stage, in millihertz.

software.description: Software that applied the filter, reusing the shared block rather than re-declaring name and version.

stage.description: Where the filter was applied (fallback when stageUri unavailable). Distinguishes BIDS HardwareFilters from SoftwareFilters.

stageUri.description: AT-URI of the filter stage definition node.

type.description: Filter type slug (fallback when typeUri unavailable).

typeUri.description: AT-URI of the filter type definition node.

MediaDefsImageInfo.description: Composable still-image metadata. Added because 0.8.0 has no image block at all, so a photograph's width and height had to borrow videoInfo, whose own description says it is for video content.

captureDevice.description: Camera or scanner, structured rather than concatenated into a format string.

codec.description: Image codec identifier (jpeg, png, webp, jp2, tiff-lzw). Wire-format code, exempt from pairing.

colorSpace.description: Colour space slug (fallback when colorSpaceUri unavailable). Paired here even though the sibling videoInfo.colorSpace is not, since a new field should not inherit an existing wart.

colorSpaceUri.description: AT-URI of the colour space definition node.

dpi.description: Resolution in dots per inch, when the image derives from a physical original.

MediaDefsMotionInfo.description: Composable motion-capture and articulography metadata: optical marker systems, inertial suits, electromagnetic articulography, ultrasound tongue imaging, and body or hand pose streams. Follows BIDS Motion, in which a tracking system is a grouping level below the session, so one session routinely carries several media records at different rates. A motion stream also carries signalInfo, because in BIDS Motion a mocap channel is typed POS, ORNT, VEL, ACCEL, GYRO, MAGN, ANGACCEL or JNTANG, that is, it is a sampled signal.

coordinateSystem.description: Carries spatialAxes; a motion stream must not define a second axis vocabulary.

format.description: Container format slug (fallback when formatUri unavailable). Wire-format code.

formatUri.description: AT-URI of the motion container format definition node.

rotationOrder.description: BIDS Motion RotationOrder (fallback when the Uri is unavailable).

rotationOrderUri.description: AT-URI of the rotation order definition node.

rotationRule.description: BIDS Motion RotationRule (fallback when the Uri is unavailable).

rotationRuleUri.description: AT-URI of the rotation handedness definition node.

skeleton.description: Skeleton or marker-set slug (fallback when skeletonUri unavailable).

skeletonUri.description: AT-URI of the skeleton or marker-set definition node (typeDef of `skeleton`), which is where joint identity, joint order and joint topology are DEFINED. This is why no pose anchor is needed: the channels carry the numbers, this carries their meaning.

trackedPointCount.description: Number of tracked points, markers, or joints.

trackingSystem.description: The pub.layers.acquisition.defs#run or session stream grouping this system, as an objectRef. BIDS Motion tracksys entity, a bare label upstream.

MediaDefsNamedPoint.description: A named point in the enclosing coordinate system, in that system's unit.

nameUri.description: AT-URI of the landmark definition node.

x.description: Signed X coordinate of the point, in the enclosing system's unit.

y.description: Signed Y coordinate of the point, in the enclosing system's unit.

z.description: Signed Z coordinate of the point, in the enclosing system's unit.

MediaDefsSensorSpec.description: Physical placement of one sensor: an EEG electrode, an iEEG contact, a MEG coil, an fNIRS optode, a motion marker, or an anatomical landmark. Coordinates are signed integer nanometres in the frame named by the enclosing coordinateSystem.

anatomyRef.description: Grounded anatomical localization. NWB makes electrodes.location a required column and BIDS iEEG carries it free text; use source uberon. For iEEG this is a subject-specific claim about a subject-specific brain and inherits the participant's identifiability declaration.

contactAreaSquareMicrometres.description: BIDS iEEG electrodes.tsv size, a REQUIRED column, square millimetres upstream. Load-bearing for current-density interpretation.

features.description: Open-ended per-sensor features not captured by the typed fields.

group.description: Electrode group or shaft. NWB ElectrodeGroup, whose name, description, location and device are all required there.

hemisphere.description: Hemisphere slug (fallback when hemisphereUri unavailable). BIDS iEEG electrodes.tsv hemisphere.

hemisphereUri.description: AT-URI of the hemisphere definition node.

material.description: Material slug (fallback when materialUri unavailable). BIDS electrodes.tsv material, free text upstream, where Ag/AgCl already has three predictable spellings.

materialUri.description: AT-URI of the electrode material definition node (typeDef of `electrode-material`).

name.description: Sensor name exactly as in the raw file.

type.description: Sensor type slug (fallback when typeUri unavailable). BIDS optodes.tsv type is REQUIRED and takes source or detector; the rest cover the electrode, coil, marker and landmark cases BIDS spreads across electrodes.tsv and coordsystem.json.

typeUri.description: AT-URI of the sensor type definition node (typeDef of `sensor-type`).

uuid.description: Stable identifier within this record. Required because channels, anchors and spatial regions point at sensors.

xNanometres.description: Signed X. BIDS electrodes.tsv x and optodes.tsv x, REQUIRED columns; NWB electrodes.x.

MediaDefsSignalChannel.description: One recorded channel. BIDS channels.tsv, whose name, type and units columns are REQUIRED for every electrophysiology modality and which additionally makes low_cutoff and high_cutoff REQUIRED for iEEG. Position is held by reference through sensor, because channel and sensor are not in one-to-one correspondence.

detectorSensor.description: Receiving optode. BIDS NIRS channels.tsv detector, a REQUIRED column.

features.description: Open-ended per-channel features not captured by the typed fields.

group.description: Electrode group, shaft, grid, or tracking system this channel belongs to. NWB ElectrodeGroup; BIDS Motion tracksys.

highCutoffMilliHz.description: Low-pass cutoff. BIDS channels.tsv high_cutoff, a REQUIRED column for iEEG.

lowCutoffMilliHz.description: High-pass cutoff. 0 means DC-coupled. BIDS channels.tsv low_cutoff, a REQUIRED column for iEEG.

name.description: Channel name exactly as in the raw file (Cz, MEG0113, S1-D1-760, gaze_x).

referenceChannel.description: Per-channel reference for bipolar and mixed intracranial montages. BIDS channels.tsv reference.

samplingFrequencyMilliHz.description: Per-channel rate when it differs from the recording's nominal rate, routine for auxiliary channels multiplexed into one file.

sensor.description: The sensors entry this channel reads from. How a channel acquires a position without duplicating coordinates per channel.

sourceSensor.description: Emitting optode. BIDS NIRS channels.tsv source, a REQUIRED column.

status.description: Channel quality slug (fallback when statusUri unavailable). BIDS channels.tsv status.

statusDescription.description: Why the channel is bad or interpolated. BIDS channels.tsv status_description.

statusUri.description: AT-URI of the channel status definition node.

type.description: Channel type slug (fallback when typeUri unavailable). Union of the BIDS keyword sets, uppercase as BIDS spells them.

typeUri.description: AT-URI of the channel type definition node (typeDef of `channel-type` at layers-acquisition.ontology.layers.pub). The authoritative field: the union of the BIDS EEG, MEG, iEEG, NIRS and Motion keyword sets already runs to roughly sixty terms and grows with each extension proposal. The knownValues below are a seed, not a closed list.

unit.description: Physical unit of this channel's samples (fallback when unitUri unavailable). BIDS channels.tsv units, REQUIRED, which expects SI units.

unitUri.description: AT-URI of the physical unit definition node (typeDef of `si-unit`).

uuid.description: Stable identifier for this channel within this record. Required because anchors, reference declarations and sync declarations point at channels, and a name or a positional index silently mis-addresses when a republished recording drops two bad channels.

wavelengthPicometres.description: Nominal wavelength (760 nm = 760000). BIDS NIRS channels.tsv wavelength_nominal, a REQUIRED column.

MediaDefsSignalInfo.description: Composable metadata for a sampled time-series recording. Attach to any media record of kind signal or motion. Frequencies are millihertz because BIDS types SamplingFrequency as number and 512.03 Hz occurs; lengths are nanometres because iEEG contact localization is reported sub-millimetre; times are session-relative nanoseconds, never UTC-epoch, since 2^53 ns is about 104 days.

associatedEmptyRoomRef.description: AT-URI of a pub.layers.media.media holding the empty-room noise recording. BIDS AssociatedEmptyRoom is a filesystem path; an AT-URI is the structured form of the same relation.

channelCount.description: Total recorded channels. BIDS EEGChannelCount / MEGChannelCount / NIRSChannelCount. Authoritative when channels is not fully enumerated.

channels.description: Per-channel table in acquisition order. BIDS channels.tsv, whose name, type and units columns are REQUIRED. Inline rather than one record per channel: getRepo bulk export is fast and unmetered while listRecords caps at 100 per page, and a montage is one logical object.

cogAtlasRef.description: Cognitive Atlas term for the task. BIDS CogAtlasID is RECOMMENDED on every electrophysiology and behavioural sidecar. Use source cognitive-atlas.

coordinateSystem.description: Frame in which sensors coordinates are expressed. BIDS coordsystem.json.

detectorOptodeCount.description: BIDS NIRSDetectorOptodeCount, REQUIRED in the NIRS sidecar.

device.description: Acquisition hardware. BIDS Manufacturer / ManufacturersModelName / DeviceSerialNumber / SoftwareVersions; NWB Device.

dewarPosition.description: MEG dewar position slug (fallback when dewarPositionUri unavailable). BIDS DewarPosition, REQUIRED in the MEG sidecar.

dewarPositionUri.description: AT-URI of the dewar position definition node.

digitizedHeadPoints.description: BIDS DigitizedHeadPoints, REQUIRED in the MEG sidecar.

digitizedLandmarks.description: BIDS DigitizedLandmarks, REQUIRED in the MEG sidecar.

epochCount.description: Number of epochs, for epoched recordings.

epochLengthNanos.description: BIDS EpochLength. Absent for continuous recordings.

eventChannel.description: The trigger or stimulus-code channel, as an objectRef into this record's channels.

eventCodes.description: Trigger codes and their meanings. BIDS events.tsv carries trial_type as a bare string; grounding each code through a typeDef lets two labs' code 12 be recognized as the same condition or as different ones.

eventLayerRef.description: AT-URI of a pub.layers.annotation.annotationLayer of kind tier holding the decoded event stream. This is where BIDS events.tsv lands: onset and duration map to anchor.temporalSpan or anchor.signalSpan, trial_type to the layer subkind or the annotation label.

features.description: Open-ended features not captured by the typed fields.

filterStatus.description: Whether filters is a complete account (fallback when filterStatusUri unavailable). BIDS makes SoftwareFilters REQUIRED and permits the literal n/a, which conflates none-applied with not-reported; separating them means an empty filters array is unambiguous.

filterStatusUri.description: AT-URI of the filter-reporting status definition node.

filters.description: Filters in application order. Carries BIDS HardwareFilters and SoftwareFilters, arbitrary untyped JSON upstream, as a typed list so a consumer can decide admissibility without parsing prose.

format.description: Container format slug (fallback when formatUri unavailable). Names what a reader must open; mimeType names the wire type, which for most of these is application/octet-stream.

formatUri.description: AT-URI of the container format definition node (typeDef of `signal-format` at layers-acquisition.ontology.layers.pub).

groundSensor.description: The ground electrode. BIDS EEGGround / iEEGGround.

headCircumferenceNanometres.description: BIDS HeadCircumference, centimetres upstream. On the recording rather than the participant because it is measured at acquisition.

modality.description: Modality slug (fallback when modalityUri unavailable). Mirrors recordingMethod.method member for member, extended with the continuous physiological channels that vocabulary omits.

modalityUri.description: AT-URI of the modality definition node: a pub.layers.ontology.typeDef of the `modality` ontology at layers-core.ontology.layers.pub, or a pub.layers.graph.graphNode. The SAME node set is named by pub.layers.judgment.defs#recordingMethod.methodUri and pub.layers.catalog.defs#contentSummary.modalityUri. Each modality node reaches its carrier node by parentTypeRef, so media.kindUri is the parent rather than a synonym. Refines modality; never replaces it.

numberOfSamples.description: Total samples per channel. With samplingFrequencyMilliHz this makes pub.layers.defs#signalSpan sample anchoring exact.

placementScheme.description: Placement scheme slug (fallback when placementSchemeUri unavailable). BIDS EEGPlacementScheme, free text upstream.

placementSchemeUri.description: AT-URI of the electrode or sensor placement definition node (typeDef of `electrode-placement`).

powerLineFrequencyMilliHz.description: Mains frequency in millihertz (50000 or 60000). BIDS PowerLineFrequency, REQUIRED in every electrophysiology sidecar: no downstream filtering decision can be made without it.

recordingDurationNanos.description: BIDS RecordingDuration, given in seconds upstream.

recordingType.description: Recording continuity slug (fallback when recordingTypeUri unavailable). BIDS RecordingType, same three values.

recordingTypeUri.description: AT-URI of the recording continuity definition node.

referenceDescription.description: Free-text reference detail for schemes the slug vocabulary cannot express. Carries BIDS EEGReference verbatim when it does not map.

referenceScheme.description: Referencing scheme slug (fallback when referenceSchemeUri unavailable). BIDS EEGReference and iEEGReference are both REQUIRED and both free text upstream; typing the common cases while keeping referenceDescription for the rest is the improvement over the upstream string.

referenceSchemeUri.description: AT-URI of the reference scheme definition node (typeDef of `eeg-reference-scheme`).

referenceSensor.description: The reference electrode, as an objectRef whose objectId names a sensors[] uuid in this record. Replaces a free-text channel name, which cannot be validated and cannot be detected as dangling.

samplingFrequencyMilliHz.description: Nominal sampling frequency in millihertz (2048 Hz = 2048000). BIDS SamplingFrequency, REQUIRED in the EEG, MEG, iEEG and NIRS sidecars; NWB ElectricalSeries.rate.

sensors.description: Physical sensor geometry. BIDS electrodes.tsv and optodes.tsv plus NWB's electrodes DynamicTable. Separate from channels because the two are not in bijection: an fNIRS channel is a source-detector-wavelength triple and a bipolar iEEG channel is a difference of two contacts.

sourceOptodeCount.description: BIDS NIRSSourceOptodeCount, REQUIRED in the NIRS sidecar.

MediaDefsSyncInfo.description: How one media stream aligns to a session's shared time base. This is what makes multimodal Layers possible: the 0.8.0 chain is annotationLayer.expression (single, REQUIRED) to expression.mediaRef (single), so a session of two cameras, a lapel microphone, an EEG cap and an eye tracker is unrepresentable, and parentMediaRef with startOffsetMs expresses excerpt-of, a different relation.

clockSource.description: How alignment was established (fallback when the Uri is unavailable). A consumer needs it to know how far to trust a cross-stream anchor: a hardware trigger and a clapperboard differ by three orders of magnitude.

clockSourceUri.description: AT-URI of the synchronization method definition node (typeDef of `sync-method`).

driftPartsPerBillion.description: Signed measured drift against the session master. Independent oscillators diverge measurably over an hour, and zero is a claim rather than a safe default.

offsetNanos.description: Signed offset from session time zero to this stream's first sample. Session-relative, never UTC-epoch. Negative when the stream began before the origin, which is normal for a continuously running amplifier and which BIDS StartTime explicitly permits.

sessionRef.description: AT-URI of the pub.layers.acquisition.session whose clock this stream is expressed against.

syncChannel.description: The channel carrying the shared sync signal, when clockSource is shared-trigger.

syncUncertaintyNanos.description: Worst-case alignment error. Bounds how finely a cross-stream anchor may honestly be read.

MediaDefsVideoInfo.description: Composable video metadata. Attach to any media record representing video content.

bitRate.description: Video bitrate in bits per second.

frameRate.description: Frame rate scaled by 100 (e.g., 2997 = 29.97fps). Avoids floats.

scanType.description: Scan type. Affects frame extraction for annotation.

MediaDefsVolumeInfo.description: Composable metadata for volumetric imaging: fMRI runs, structural scans, and derived masks or parcellations. Volumes almost always exceed the blob cap, so externalUri plus contentDigest is the normal carriage rather than the exception.

coordinateSystem.description: Stereotaxic frame the voxel grid is expressed against.

format.description: Container format slug (fallback when formatUri unavailable). Wire-format code.

formatUri.description: AT-URI of the volume container format definition node.

sliceTimingNanos.description: Per-slice acquisition offsets within one TR. BIDS SliceTiming.

volumeKind.description: Volume kind slug (fallback when the Uri is unavailable). BIDS suffix plus datatype.

volumeKindUri.description: AT-URI of the volume kind definition node.

voxelSizeXNanometres.description: Voxel edge length along X, in nanometres.

voxelSizeYNanometres.description: Voxel edge length along Y, in nanometres.

voxelSizeZNanometres.description: Voxel edge length along Z, in nanometres.
